# Chapter 14 · Weak Identification and Nonregular Asymptotics {.unnumbered}
*Local-to-Zero Identification · Weak IV · Nonstandard Limits · Robust Inference · Singular Geometry*

regular local quadratic geometry가 약해지거나 실패할 때 무엇이 달라지는지 분석한다. weak IV, local-to-zero asymptotics, nonstandard limits, identification-robust inference, many instruments, singular information, boundary parameters, nonstandard rates를 하나의 관점에서 연결한다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **14.1–14.4** regular benchmark, identification strength, local-to-zero asymptotics, weak IV
- **14.5–14.8** 2SLS breakdown, LIML, diagnostics, identification-robust inference
- **14.9–14.11** many instruments, singular/boundary models, nonstandard rates and argmax limits
- **14.12–14.13** practical nonregular workflow, 요약과 연습문제
:::
